lines.beaver_en: How's married life? How's your father-in-law?
lines.learner: 장인어른이 참 좋으세요. 저를 아들처럼 아끼세요.
lines.en: He's really nice. He cares for me like his own son.
lines.roman: jangineoreuni cham joeuseyo. jeoreul adeulcheoreom akkiseyo.

lines.beaver_en: Wow, that's a relief. And your mother-in-law?
lines.learner: 장모님도 잘해 주세요. 제때 밥도 꼭 챙겨 주세요.
lines.en: She's good to me too. She always makes sure I eat on time.
lines.roman: jangmonimdo jalhae juseyo. jettae bapdo kkok chaenggyeo juseyo.

lines.learner: 아내네는 남매예요. 위로 형님이 한 분 계세요.
lines.en: She has one brother. He's older than her.
lines.roman: anaeneneun nammaeyeyo. wiro hyeongnimi han bun gyeseyo.

lines.beaver_en: Do you get along with him too?
lines.en: Yes. He's a devoted son and is very good to his parents.

lines.beaver_en: What about your side? Do you have siblings?
lines.learner: 아니요, 저는 외아들이에요. 그래서 대가족이 부러워요.
lines.en: No, I'm an only son. So I envy big families.
lines.roman: aniyo, jeoneun oeadeurieyo. geuraeseo daegajogi bureowoyo.

lines.beaver_en: Where do you gather on holidays?
lines.learner: 큰집에 가요. 애들이 많아서 정말 시끄러워요.
lines.en: We go to my eldest uncle's. Lots of kids, so it's really noisy.
lines.roman: keunjibe gayo. aedeuri manaseo jeongmal sikkeureowoyo.

lines.beaver_en: Does your wife get along with her in-laws?
lines.learner: 네, 저희 부모님이 아내를 딸처럼 예뻐하세요.
lines.en: Yes, my parents adore her like a daughter.
lines.roman: ne, jeohui bumonimi anaereul ttalcheoreom yeppeohaseyo.

lines.beaver_en: Is she close with your uncle's family?
lines.learner: 아내는 친언니가 없어서 큰집 누님을 따라요.
lines.en: She has no older sister, so she follows my cousin around.
lines.roman: anaeneun chineonniga eopseoseo keunjip nunimeul ttarayo.

lines.beaver: 어른들이 아기는 언제 낳냐고 안 물어요?
lines.beaver_en: Don't the elders ask when you'll have a baby?
lines.beaver_roman: eoreundeuri agineun eonje nannyago an mureoyo?
lines.en: Every time. Saying 'not yet' makes no difference.

lines.beaver: 하하, 어른들 마음이 다 그렇죠. 정말 재미있었어요.
lines.beaver_en: Haha, elders are all like that. That was fun to hear.
lines.beaver_roman: haha, eoreundeul maeumi da geureochyo. jeongmal jaemiisseosseoyo.
lines.en: Me too. Let's talk again next time.
